structured_output.evidence: 2026-10-08: collaboration.spawn_agent takes a message but no output-schema field. A brief can request the contract JSON; the runtime does not validate or refuse a malformed report. check.js is an external check.

model_per_spawn.evidence: 2026-10-08: collaboration.spawn_agent accepts model; live Luna and Sol spawns accepted explicit choices with fork_turns=none. Omitting model inherits the parent, so the rule to set it on every spawn is instructed. No refusal of an omitted or wrong choice was observed.

effort_per_spawn.evidence: 2026-10-08: collaboration.spawn_agent accepts reasoning_effort; live low, medium and high spawns accepted explicit choices with fork_turns=none. Omitting effort inherits the parent. The high cap and tier pairing are instructions; the exposed tool also lists higher efforts.

tool_restriction.evidence: 2026-10-08: the exposed collaboration.spawn_agent has no tool allowlist or agent_type argument. Children receive the parent tool surface. The agent_types names default, worker and explorer are the native Codex names at https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/agent-configuration/subagents (checked 2026-10-08). Through this wrapper they are brief instructions only. This profile describes the exposed wrapper; native Codex configuration does not constrain it.

worktree_per_task.evidence: 2026-10-08: the exposed collaboration.spawn_agent shares the directory and filesystem and has no worktree or write-boundary argument. The lead creates a Git worktree below worktree_root and puts its path in the brief. worktree_root is a repository convention of this kit, not a Codex default or a confinement boundary. No runtime refusal of an outside write was observed.

parallel_spawn.evidence: 2026-10-08: live collaboration.spawn_agent calls started independent agents concurrently. concurrency null gives the limit to the harness. That session had 4 active slots, the root included; this is not a limit of every Codex session. The contract concurrency policy remains instructed; no refusal of a contract limit breach was observed.

follow_up.evidence: 2026-10-08: collaboration.send_message and collaboration.followup_task are exposed and live messages reached running agents. Rework routing and the round cap remain brief instructions; no runtime refusal of a contract breach was observed.

interrupt.evidence: 2026-10-08: collaboration.interrupt_agent is exposed to stop an agent turn. The requirement to interrupt on a policy breach remains instructed; no automatic refusal or interruption was observed.

usage_report.evidence: 2026-10-08: the exposed collaboration tools return agent state and reports, without per-agent token or dollar totals. Account usage limits are not task metrics. Report tokens and cost_usd as unavailable.

image_generation.evidence: 2026-10-08: the exposed image_gen.imagegen tool generates or edits raster images from prompt, with transparent_background and reference-image arguments. Tool availability is verified from the live session signature. The brief must request its use and review the result; no runtime refusal for bypassing image generation was observed.
